phishing_source_note: PhishTank's public feed (the source originally specified) was found to be unreliably rate-limited during development — one request returned real data, the next returned a CloudFront placeholder image instead of JSON. OpenPhish was substituted: no API key needed, verified stable, and already cited in this thesis's Chapter 2 literature review.
legitimate_source_note: Tranco publishes a new dated list daily; this dataset used whatever list was current as of built_at_utc above. Cite Tranco with the date this was built, consistent with Tranco's own citation guidance for research use.
